{{Top|leg}}
The '''kata-wata''' was a leafy [[Color/Legends|green]] [[Fern (plant)/Legends|fern]] that grew on [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. The [[Ewok/Legends|Ewoks]] used the leaves of the fern for building materials, and they also extracted liquid out of the stem, which was used to stop [[Blood/Legends|bleeding]] and help prevent infection.
